notes.title: Version 1.1.0
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45568200/0f24fc544081160c91b0deda177202985bc2817c.png[/img]

[list]

[*] [b]Battle UI:[/b] Version 1.1.0 refreshes the Battle UI to be more modern and mobile friendly. We understand that players have been using the original UI for a long time and it will take time to get used to the new UI. We hope that you adjust to it quickly!

[*] [b]Steam, steam and steam![/b] This version adds support for direct registration and login via Steam as well as linking your Steam profile to existing accounts.

[*] [b]In Game Payments:[/b] Much requested IAPs are finally are live for steam users. Players can now purchase Platinum, Gold and Gems through in the in-game shop if playing through Steam.

[*] Breeding price has been reduced to 3,000 Gold.

[*] Daily Quests don't enforce winning arena games anymore.

[/list]

List of past updates and changes can be found on the website [url=https://worldofmiscrits.com/updates]here[/url].

This version brings minor changes along with the Steam release. 

[list]

[*] Random Arena rewards were updated in amount and number of wins

[/list]
